title: S Voicing & X Pronunciation Patterns
objectives: Apply S voicing rules between vowels and after voiced sounds
Predict X pronunciations (/ks/, /gz/, /z/) based on stress

teacherNotes.content: Present the pronunciation/reading rule for: S Voicing & X Pronunciation Patterns. Use the 14 Gabarit fields to clarify rule, system, logic, and exceptions.

teacherNotes.title: Anticipated Problems & Solutions (CELTA Standard)
teacherNotes.content:
⚠️ Problem: Learner says /bɒgz/ for "box".
💡 Solution: Contrast voiceless box /bɒks/ with voiced examine /ɪɡˈzæmɪn/.

elements.content: Gabarit 14 Champs: S Voicing & X Pronunciation Patterns
1. Definition: The letter S alternates between voiceless /s/ and voiced /z/, and X alternates between /ks/ and /gz/.

2. Rule: 1. S becomes voiced /z/ between two vowels (music, reason) and after voiced sounds (moms, kings). 2. X = /ks/ by default (box, next); X = /gz/ before a stressed vowel (examine, exist); X = /z/ at word start (xylophone).
3. Why? Voice assimilation streamlines airflow between vocalic sounds.
4. How to recognize? Check surrounding vowels and stress position for S and X.
5. Common examples: music /ˈmjuːzɪk/, reason /ˈriːzən/, box /bɒks/, examine /ɪɡˈzæmɪn/, exist /ɪɡˈzɪst/, xylophone /ˈzaɪləfoʊn/
6. Counter-examples: basic /ˈbeɪsɪk/ (S remains /s/ exception).
7. Exceptions: basic, basin, bison (/s/ between vowels).
8. Common mistakes: Pronouncing X as /ks/ in "examine" (*ek-samine instead of eg-zamine).
9. Mnemonic / Hint: S between vowels = /z/! X before STRESSED vowel = /gz/!
10. Key vocabulary: S voicing, X pronunciation, intervocalic, voice assimilation, sibilant
11. Frequency: ★★★★☆ (High)
12. CEFR Level: 🟠 B1
13. Associated Visual: 🐝 Buzzing bee for /z/ and /gz/ vs Snake hiss for /s/ and /ks/.
14. Key Takeaway: S between vowels = /z/! X before stressed vowel = /gz/!

teacherNotes.title: Teacher CCQ Script
teacherNotes.content: Ask these concept checking questions to verify rule understanding without translation:

elements.content: Rule Understanding Check (CCQ):
CCQ 1: Why is S pronounced as /z/ in "music"? (Because it is between two vowels)
CCQ 2: How is X pronounced in "box" vs "examine"? (/ks/ in box; /gz/ in examine before stressed vowel)
CCQ 3: How is X pronounced at the beginning of "xylophone"? (/z/ sound)

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Auditory discrimination, minimal pairs, and guided oral drill repetition.

elements.content: Determine whether S/X is voiced (/z/, /gz/) or voiceless (/s/, /ks/):
🎯 Item: music ➔ Answer / Pronunciation: Voiced S (/z/)
🎯 Item: box ➔ Answer / Pronunciation: Voiceless X (/ks/)
🎯 Item: exist ➔ Answer / Pronunciation: Voiced X (/gz/ before stressed vowel)
